about.title: About Me
about.message: Hello, my name is Tran. I graduated with a major in Information Systems and I am currently seeking an opportunity as a Software Engineer (Backend or Frontend). I have experience building modern, user-friendly web interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, along with a basic foundation in backend development with Java Spring Boot. I have worked on UI development, state management, and API integration, and I also have an understanding of system design and API development. My goal is to grow as a well-rounded Software Engineer with strong technical skills and a product-oriented mindset, contributing long-term value to the team and the company.

contact.message: Thank you for reviewing my portfolio. I am open to Frontend Developer opportunities and would welcome the opportunity to connect.
